root_cause: Ordinary ASan realigned callers invoke preserve_none callbacks directly. ASan fallback allocas are outside entry blocks; the caller then needs a base pointer that the native invoke mask clobbers. The backend diagnostic does not establish an escaping alloca in the native callback.
fix: The ordinary fixed entry bridge moves the native invoke out of the realigned caller. Actual callback and caller instrumentation remains enabled; no test logging/state code was changed for this repair.
qualification: Cross x86-64 code generation with libstdc++15 only; actual native libstdc++13 qualification remains separate.
